notes: Three routes meet at «قالوا حدثنا» (rule 3): the three names before it are the three branches, and the names written once after it are the shared tail.
«ولا أعلمه إلا عن أنس بن مالك» is the narrator's own statement of the source; Anas is read as the last link because the saying follows «قال» (rule 6).
